decision_log.status: Team endorsement reported by Yufei Cai
decision_log.accepted: Full assessment defaults to seven experts; focused requests use rule-based routing. Independent of synthesis, check evidence, scoped authorization and readiness. Produce one recommended action, with final disposition reserved for humans.
decision_log.alternative: Always run all seven for every question to maximize visibility. This reduces missed dependencies but adds cost, wait and irrelevant discussion in a narrow brief. Another alternative, allowing autonomous model-based routing and resolution, was not taken because it can silently omit decisive authority.
decision_log.reopen: Expand focused routing or remove it if tests omit a material issue; re-evaluate scheduling after TW11 measures burden. Any unclear action label or detected permission bypass blocks release until repaired. Preserve the material tradeoff between speed to learn and avoiding out-of-scope execution.

integration_issues.exit_evidence: A4/A5 two-person review, routing comparison and an exact reroute test.

tw11_handoff: Confirm actual integration repository and appoint implementation/review roles; copy rather than edit pinned cores.
Implement envelope validation, deterministic routing and append-only logging; replay full/focused/missing-scope controls.
Wire the seven interactive expert adapters, independent gate, decision card and human disposition. No external model API or operating connector is required for the first integration tests.
Run the predefined matrix with synthetic data; keep failed traces, conduct independent human review, and freeze a named version only after all release assertions pass.
